term: component, cut and foundation versus joint supply
resolution: A source of the condensation is a reachability-minimal component; it can contain no intrinsic event. Condensed Supply discards contributors inside the effect's component and is therefore weaker than Supply. GraphCut reads the projected graph while Trap reads whole records; a graph cut with nonempty contributor sets is a Trap and the converse fails. Trap reads record membership and does not follow scenario indispensability: the same contributor can be indispensable over one allowed-scenario space and redundant over another. No use here passes from any of these to actual productive explanation, an ultimate foundation or a necessary being. See docs/notes/scc-sufficiency-752.md.
